purpose: 문법 추출에 필요한 구조·문구·시간 관측의 반복성, 오류·기권, 검수 부담을 제한된 별도 자료에서 확인

reference.stage: A5b preparation before any primary output
reference.reference_author_type_default: AI reference with separate audit; not human gold
reference.insufficient_reference_result: scope_inconclusive; preserve original windows and report actual denominator

quality_gates.applies_to: each of the 8 fixed-skill primary runs; repeat joint coverage for each window; no averaging away a failed run
critical_error_examples: 새 AI 관측을 기존 사용자 승인으로 기재
quality_gates.threshold_status: prospective engineering acceptance limits, not A4 empirical performance estimates or statistical guarantees

metric_definitions.core_coverage: correct matched judgable core atoms / all judgable core reference atoms
metric_definitions.detail_coverage: correct matched judgable detail atoms / all judgable detail reference atoms
metric_definitions.asserted_claim_precision: supported unique asserted factual atoms / all unique asserted factual atoms, including claims outside the reference list
metric_definitions.avoidable_abstention_fraction: judgable core+detail atoms marked unknown despite available permitted evidence / all judgable core+detail reference atoms; these also remain missed coverage atoms
metric_definitions.repeat_joint_detail_coverage: judgable detail atoms correctly matched in both repeats / all judgable detail reference atoms
metric_definitions.boundary_interval_distance: max(0, reference_start - reported_end, reported_start - reference_end); exact evidence PTS identity is a separate zero-error provenance gate
metric_definitions.uncertainty: genuine evidence-indeterminate easing may remain unknown without penalty; direction/order/existence remain scored; definite unsupported claims are errors
metric_definitions.duplicates_and_conflicts: duplicate semantic claims count once; contradiction is not cured by also writing a correct alternative; critical contradictions fail the zero-error gate
metric_definitions.rounding: success counts must meet ceil(threshold * denominator); maximum counts use floor(threshold * denominator); no rounding up a ratio to pass
metric_definitions.zero_denominator: null plus reason and scope-inconclusive; never treat 0/0 as 100 percent
metric_definitions.inapplicable: judge before looking at run results, state reason, preserve count; do not remove a failed item after scoring

review_budget.time_kind: review task elapsed time with unrelated waiting paused; actual human active time and AI elapsed time recorded separately

overall_resource_budget.missing_telemetry: null plus reason; no inferred historical human time or token cost

value_comparison.if_baseline_quality_fails: do not advertise a cheap inaccurate baseline as equal-quality comparator
value_comparison.if_quality_passes_but_value_unproved: quality pass / benefit inconclusive; no automatic default promotion

stop_policy.legacy_failure: stop before exposing the new videos; preserve output and report candidate revision required
stop_policy.critical_primary_failure: critical error in with_skill stops all remaining analyses in this batch; baseline errors alone do not stop candidate evaluation; preserve outputs and report planned-versus-actual counts
stop_policy.noncritical_failure: continue only frozen runs within resource caps; no mid-test skill or criterion editing
stop_policy.budget_exhaustion: stop at cap, record unresolved coverage as incomplete/inconclusive, do not silently extend
stop_policy.unscorable_reference: scope-inconclusive; no invented truth or replacement samples
stop_policy.revision_after_new_material_seen: that material becomes development/regression material; no fresh-heldout relabel on rerun
